payload.title: M2 Import with a plan: create-only, explicit replace
payload.description: papyrus publication import --bundle DIR --dry-run prints a plan per kind (create, update, unchanged, conflict); default create-only never overwrites newer backend edits; --replace KIND updates with version bumps and audit fields; refuses a bundle for a different publication key unless --as-publication. Replaces the per-kind one-off imports (sections import, import-doctrine, starter packs, catalog, import-markus) with one path, keeping those as thin wrappers.
